name: Taming the Beast
summary: In Bloodhoof Village, Yaw Sharpmane sets a young tauren hunter a new trial. The hunter must master the swift prairie stalker.

sections.title: The Stalker's Lessons
sections.body: After mastering the adult plainstrider’s endurance, you face a different kind of hunter. Prairie stalkers rely on speed, move in packs, and attack without fear. To tame one, you must approach this cunning predator without breaking stride, matching the wolf’s decisive nature.

sections.title: Muscle to Muscle
sections.body: Yaw Sharpmane teaches you that hunting beside a beast means neither servitude nor brute force. You and the predator must fight as one, joined by respect and shared rhythm. Bonding with a prairie stalker under Mulgore’s open skies teaches you to complement your companion’s attacks and move with it in battle.

faq.q: What animal does Yaw Sharpmane ask me to tame in this trial?
faq.answer: Yaw Sharpmane asks you to tame a prairie stalker, a swift wolf that prowls Mulgore’s plains.

faq.q: Why does a tauren hunter learn to tame wolves?
faq.answer: Yaw Sharpmane teaches that prairie stalkers embody speed and fearlessness. Bonding with one helps you learn those traits and coordinate attacks with a swift hunting partner.

faq.q: Where can prairie stalkers usually be found?
faq.answer: Prairie stalkers roam the grassy plains of central and northern Mulgore, including the prairies around Bloodhoof Village.

faq.q: Do I get to keep the prairie stalker after the quest?
faq.answer: No. The taming rod forms only a temporary bond for training. After completing all the trials, you gain the lasting ability to tame any wild companion you choose.
Yaw Sharpmane is the hunter trainer in Bloodhoof Village. He guides young tauren through the spiritual and practical steps of mastering Mulgore’s wilds.

faq.q: What comes after taming the prairie stalker?
faq.answer: After Yaw Sharpmane confirms you have mastered the wolf, he sends you to the third and final trial, where you face the stealthy swoop.

angles.text: As a hunter, you learn to join survival skills with coordinated attacks, fighting beside a swift companion.
As a tauren, you follow the Shu'halo way of beast taming: forging a sacred kinship under the Earthmother’s watchful grace.
